maddeler.e:
نتقامر (form VI)
# نَتَقَامَرُ (nataqāmaru) /na.ta.qaː.ma.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَامَرَ (taqāmara)
# نَتَقَامَرَ (nataqāmara) /na.ta.qaː.ma.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَامَرَ (taqāmara)
# نَتَقَامَرْ (nataqāmar) /na.ta.qaː.mar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَامَرَ (taqāmara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
